item.title: Galway medtech company gets EU regulatory approval for Vein Infusion device
item.description: InVera Medical, a Galway based medtech company, has received European regulatory approval for a new minimally invasive device designed to help physicians deliver treatment more effectively to diseased leg veins, including varicose veins. The approval, known as a CE Mark, allows the company’s InVera Infusion Device to be marketed and used across the European Union. […]
